macro.label: S&P 500 and VIX
macro.text: The S&P 500 closed at 7,376.86 after a 2.68% weekly decline. VIX ended at 25.64, up 6.22 points for the week.

macro.label: Inflation reports
macro.text: Tuesday's CPI forecast is 3.9%, up from 3.7%. Friday's PPI forecast is 6.6%, up from 6.3%.

macro.label: AI earnings
macro.text: CoreWeave reports Tuesday after the close. Cisco and Applied Materials report Thursday, followed by Nvidia on November 17.

macro.label: Sizing and later dates
macro.text: Consider half-size positions and a buy-to-close order at 50% of the premium. November 20 expiries carry Nvidia's November 17 report and the Fed's November 18 minutes. December 18 expiries also carry the December 9 Fed decision.

days.name: Monday
days.rule: Wait for Tuesday's inflation report. This slate has no Monday entry window.
days.event: New York Fed consumer survey at 8:00 AM Pacific. KKR and Constellation Energy report.

days.name: Tuesday
days.rule: Enter after 7:00 AM Pacific and after CPI is released. If the report is delayed, wait. Consider half-size positions with VIX in the mid-20s. Below the 3.9% forecast, consider a wider cushion; above it, consider a lower strike.
days.event: October CPI at 5:30 AM Pacific (3.9% forecast; 3.7% prior). The 10-year Treasury auction is at 10:00 AM Pacific. CoreWeave reports after the close.

trades.note: The entry window follows KKR's Monday earnings.
Carries the November 25 PCE report and December 4 jobs report.

days.name: Wednesday
days.rule: Enter after 7:00 AM Pacific, once the market has reacted to CoreWeave's results. If AI shares rise, consider keeping a wider cushion. If they fall, consider a lower strike.
days.event: Veterans Day: the bond market is closed; stocks and options trade normally. Corteva reports. Cisco and Applied Materials report Thursday.

days.name: Thursday
days.rule: No new entries from this slate. Wait for Cisco and Applied Materials earnings and Friday's producer price report before the covered-call window.
days.event: Weekly jobless claims at 5:30 AM Pacific. The 30-year Treasury auction is at 10:00 AM Pacific. Cisco and Applied Materials report.

days.name: Friday
days.rule: Enter after 7:00 AM Pacific, following PPI and Thursday's earnings. A covered call requires 100 shares and a sale price you accept. If shares rise, consider a higher strike; if they fall, consider waiting rather than lowering the sale price.
days.event: October PPI at 5:30 AM Pacific (6.6% forecast; 6.3% prior). Cisco and Applied Materials results are available.

trades.note: Consider only if $60 is an acceptable share sale price.
